member.name: T:ArcGIS.Desktop.Internal.DataReviewer.Utilities.CollectionBinding
member.summary: Class to help with binding to collections in WPF
member.remarks: Core has a CollectionBindingHelper class which this class is modeled after however I found it cumbersome to use their class with complex UI's as you have to declare 3 or 4 objects for each collection you want to bind to in the UI: (collection instance, CollectionBindingHelper instance, lock instance, and possibly readonly wrapper instance). This class tries to make it simple to have many bindable collections within a viewmodel.

member.name: M:ArcGIS.Desktop.Internal.DataReviewer.Utilities.CollectionBinding.EnableSynchronization``2(``0@,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Enables a generic collection C of type T (e.g. ObservableCollection<String>) that is used in WPF binding to be accessible/modifiable from threads other than the UI thread.

member.name: T:ArcGIS.Desktop.Internal.DataReviewer.Utilities.CollectionItem`1
member.summary: A class to encapsulate an item in a collection you want to bind to.
member.remarks: Many times you want to bind to a collection of objects (layers, subtypes, etc) but those objects do not display correctly when you bind to a collection of them. This class will allow you to correctly display the collection of objects and get a reference to the object when it is selected. If Equals function is supplied it will be used for equality comparison, otherwise if T implements IEquatable it will be used, otherwise reference equality on underlying T item is used. You must know which equals function to use when setting SelectedValue on UI elements bound to CollectionItem<T> .
